en: This is a color postcard showing a picturesque European town square with historic buildings. The structure on the left is adorned with a painted mural depicting a medieval figure and a lengthy inscription in German. The building on the right has a step-gabled roof, a small clock tower, and numerous flower boxes on its windows. There are tables with umbrellas set out on the cobbled square, suggesting a café or restaurant. The scene is framed by the shadow of an archway.
